description: Automatic Google Drive organizer. Scans Drive structure and file contents, builds a personalized preference profile, applies domain-specific logic (taxes by year, projects by name, home by system, finance by institution), and executes non-destructive moves, renames, and description writes. Learns organizational style over time and auto-approves consistently accepted patterns. Never deletes files. NOT for web research, document analysis, or Chronicle ingestion.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
